_readme: Every place on the page, pinned. coords are [longitude, latitude]. Some coordinates are approximate (within a few hundred meters); the popup's Google Maps link searches by name, so directions are always exact. Add a place by adding an entry; the page needs no other change. Optional fields: note, maps_url.

recommendations.name: Khirokitia
recommendations.note: The 9,000-year-old settlement. Step inside the reconstructions.

recommendations.name: Cyprus Museum, Nicosia
recommendations.note: Nine millennia in one hour. See it before the collection moves.

recommendations.name: Leventis Museum, Nicosia
recommendations.note: Free, and the best-told story on the island. Go before the Green Line.

recommendations.name: Petra tou Romiou
recommendations.note: Aphrodite's birthplace. A stop, not a destination.

recommendations.name: Sanctuary of Aphrodite, Kouklia
recommendations.note: Fifteen centuries of pilgrims. Usually empty now.

recommendations.name: Kourion
recommendations.note: Theatre on a sea cliff. Late afternoon; no shade.

recommendations.name: Kato Paphos Archaeological Park
recommendations.note: The mosaic floors, where they were laid.

recommendations.name: Tombs of the Kings
recommendations.note: Climb down into the chambers.

recommendations.name: Amathus
recommendations.note: An ancient kingdom, usually all yours.

recommendations.name: Troodos Geopark Visitor Centre
recommendations.note: Forty-five minutes that upgrade the whole mountain. See it first.

recommendations.name: Artemis Trail
recommendations.note: Circles the summit at 1,850 m, nearly flat. Bring a layer.

recommendations.name: Teisia tis Madaris
recommendations.note: The best views per kilometer in Cyprus. Often above the clouds.

recommendations.name: Caledonia Falls
recommendations.note: Lush, lovely, busy. Weekday morning; trout at Psilo Dendro after.

recommendations.name: Red Lake, Mitsero
recommendations.note: Toxic, beautiful, thirty minutes from Nicosia.

recommendations.name: Mathiatis mines
recommendations.note: The rest of the colour palette: yellow, brown, orange.

recommendations.name: Tzelefos Bridge
recommendations.note: The camel bridge, deep in the Paphos Forest.

recommendations.name: Agios Nikolaos tis Stegis
recommendations.note: The UNESCO barn-roof church, walkable from old Kakopetria.

recommendations.name: Church of Saint Lazarus, Larnaca
recommendations.note: The crypt is the point.

recommendations.name: Angeloktisti, Kiti
recommendations.note: A 6th-century mosaic whose only peer is at Mount Sinai.

recommendations.name: Ledra Street crossing
recommendations.note: Passport, a few minutes, another world.

recommendations.name: Buyuk Han
recommendations.note: Ottoman caravanserai, workshops and coffee.

recommendations.name: Selimiye Mosque
recommendations.note: The island's oldest great Gothic building, wearing minarets.

recommendations.name: Home for Cooperation
recommendations.note: Coffee inside the buffer zone.

recommendations.name: Bemba (Μπέμπα)
recommendations.note: Modern Cypriot cooking in the old town.

recommendations.name: Topika Meze Bar
recommendations.note: The meze stop of the food row.

recommendations.name: Rokoko Kitchen & Bar
recommendations.note: For the bar end of the evening.

recommendations.name: Granazi (γρανάζι)
recommendations.note: Bar with the right vibe and good food.

recommendations.name: Hamam Omerye
recommendations.note: A bathhouse since the 14th century. Book a treatment.

recommendations.name: OXI Market
recommendations.note: On the Venetian walls, Wednesday and Saturday, before ten.

recommendations.name: Loukoumades Kyrillis
recommendations.note: Frying the same thing since 1965. No menu needed.

recommendations.name: Famagusta walled city
recommendations.note: Venetian walls and a Gothic cathedral-mosque. Morning, before Varosha.

recommendations.name: Varosha
recommendations.note: The sealed town. Go quietly, on foot, off season.

recommendations.name: Ancient Salamis
recommendations.note: The gymnasium colonnade against the sea. Bring your own interpretation.

recommendations.name: St Hilarion Castle
recommendations.note: The best view on the island. Hours obey the army, not the website.

recommendations.name: Bellapais Abbey
recommendations.note: Where Durrell wrote Bitter Lemons.

recommendations.name: Kyrenia Castle
recommendations.note: A 2,300-year-old shipwreck, almonds still in the hold.

recommendations.name: Zenobia wreck
recommendations.note: A top-ten wreck dive, minutes off Larnaca.

recommendations.name: MUSAN
recommendations.note: A museum you snorkel through.

recommendations.name: Cape Greco sea caves
recommendations.note: Kayak the cliffs until the end of October.

recommendations.name: Nissi Beach
recommendations.note: The postcard one. Wade to the island.

recommendations.name: Fig Tree Bay
recommendations.note: Regularly on Europe's best-beach lists, honestly.

recommendations.name: Konnos Bay
recommendations.note: Between the two, and quieter.

recommendations.name: Baths of Aphrodite trailhead
recommendations.note: Start of the Adonis and Aphrodite loop. Adonis first.

recommendations.name: Avakas Gorge
recommendations.note: Three meters wide, thirty meters deep. Real shoes.

recommendations.name: Blue Lagoon, Akamas
recommendations.note: Exactly as beautiful as the photos.

recommendations.name: Lara Bay
recommendations.note: Turtles June to September; solitude always. Unpaved on purpose.

recommendations.name: Kensington Cliffs
recommendations.note: The griffon vulture colony. Mid-morning thermals, nobody there.

recommendations.name: Stavros tis Psokas
recommendations.note: Mouflon enclosure; closed March 2026 as a precaution, check before driving.

recommendations.name: Larnaca Salt Lake
recommendations.note: Flamingos November to March; a salt mirror in summer.

recommendations.name: Akrotiri marsh
recommendations.note: The island's richest birding, year round.

recommendations.name: Sofia & Andreas, Letymbou
recommendations.note: Halloumi made in front of you, lunch at the family table. Book ahead.

recommendations.name: Hercules Fish Tavern, Zygi
recommendations.note: Order the calamari.

recommendations.name: Xefoto, Zygi
recommendations.note: Its own boats catch what it serves.

recommendations.name: To souvlaki tou Soukri, Paralimni
recommendations.note: The souvlaki worth a detour.

recommendations.name: Adamos Tavern, Lefkara
recommendations.note: What the village recommends to its own.

recommendations.name: Katoi, Omodos
recommendations.note: Clay-oven kleftiko, worth the coaches outside.

recommendations.name: To Anoi, Kakopetria
recommendations.note: The local answer in Kakopetria.

recommendations.name: Kolossi Castle
recommendations.note: Twenty-five minutes for the Commandaria story, en route to Kourion.

recommendations.name: Zambartas Winery
recommendations.note: The best tasting on the island; indigenous grapes.

recommendations.name: Vlassides Winery, Kilani
recommendations.note: The reference Shiraz; eat in Kilani, not Omodos.

recommendations.name: Kyperounda Winery
recommendations.note: Xynisteri at 1,400 meters, below the Madari ridge.

recommendations.name: Tsiakkas Winery, Pelendri
recommendations.note: Dry wines to Commandaria, from a terrace over the valley.

recommendations.name: Revecca Winery, Agios Mamas
recommendations.note: Commandaria at the source, poured in the old family house.

recommendations.name: Casale Panayiotis, Kalopanayiotis
recommendations.note: Luxury woven through a living spa village. Steep lanes.

recommendations.name: Apokryfo, Lofou
recommendations.note: The boutique version, fifteen minutes from the wineries.

recommendations.name: Anassa
recommendations.note: The resort whose service earns it. Eat at Latchi nearby.

recommendations.name: Latchi harbour
recommendations.note: Fish tavernas on the quay; the honest lunch on an Akamas day.
